name: Pescao
author: FranjeGueje
description: Frame generation and scaling profiles for MAKO Renderer: edit them and choose one per game.

items.label: Prepare frame generation
items.hint: Sets frame generation up when the game starts. Turn off only to use scaling alone. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: Generate frames
items.hint: Turns generation on or off live; off is MAKO's 0x position, without losing the rest of the profile.

items.label: Adaptive
items.hint: Varies the generated frames toward a target frame rate instead of a fixed multiplier.

items.label: Multiplier
items.hint: Total frames shown per real frame: 2 doubles the frame rate. Start with 2 and go up only if it helps.

items.label: Base FPS cap
items.hint: Caps the game's real frames; 0 is off. Set by Steady base cap while that's on. Setting a cap turns Dynamic cadence recovery off.

items.label: Gamescope VRR
items.hint: Follow Steam leaves VRR alone. On/Off request it while this game runs, on displays that support VRR.

items.label: Target FPS
items.hint: Output frame rate to aim for. A goal, not a promise: an unreachable target is simply missed.

items.label: Max multiplier
items.hint: The most frames Adaptive may show per real frame.

items.label: Steady base cap
items.hint: Caps real frames at half the target for an even cadence. Can cost responsiveness. Turns Dynamic cadence recovery off.

items.label: Real frame priority
items.hint: With Steady base cap off (fractional Adaptive): keeps more real frames in the mix. Higher can lower latency and artifacts, but pacing may feel less even. Turns Dynamic cadence recovery off.

items.label: Smooth cadence
items.hint: Favours an even, validated delivery pattern. Compare on and off in each game.

items.label: Scaling
items.hint: Upscales the game's image. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: Method
items.hint: LS1 needs Lossless.dll (falls back to MAKO Scaler if it fails); MAKO Scaler doesn't. Ultra performance uses LS1 Performance.

items.label: Scale factor
items.hint: Output size over source size, per side: 1.5 turns 720p into 1080p. Lower the in-game resolution to match.

items.label: Sharpness
items.hint: Sharpening strength after scaling.

items.label: Quality supersampling
items.hint: Lets variable Gamescope surfaces render beyond the display before downsampling.

items.label: Flow scale
items.hint: Resolution used to estimate motion. Lower is lighter on the GPU but less precise.

items.label: Lighter model
items.hint: Uses the lighter frame generation model: faster, slightly lower quality.

items.label: Ultra performance
items.hint: A preset: flow scale 0.7, the lighter model and FP16 (and LS1 Performance when scaling), locked while it's on. Turning it off puts flow scale back to 0.8. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: GPU
items.hint: GPU name, vendor:device id or PCI bus id. Leave empty to let MAKO choose. Applies on the next launch.

items.label: Pause at refresh rate
items.hint: Pauses generation when Gamescope reports a refresh rate at or below this; 0 is off.

items.label: Dynamic cadence recovery
items.hint: Rechecks the game's native cadence, for games that change frame rate between menus and play. Turning it on clears the real-frame caps (Base FPS cap, Steady base cap, Real frame priority).

items.label: Recovery interval
items.hint: How often the cadence is rechecked.

items.label: Game swapchain images
items.hint: Keeps the game's own swapchain image count. Only for games that won't start otherwise. Applies on the next launch.

global.label: Allow FP16
global.hint: Lets frame generation use half precision where the GPU supports it. Ultra performance turns it on. Applies on the next launch.

global.label: Lossless.dll path
global.hint: Where Lossless.dll is. Leave empty to let MAKO find it. Frame generation and LS1 need it.

launcher.label: Zink
launcher.hint: Runs OpenGL games through Vulkan (Mesa's Zink), for OpenGL games that need it. All games started with mako-launch, from their next start.

launcher.label: Force ALSA audio
launcher.hint: Uses ALSA audio in SDL and Wine/Proton instead of PulseAudio. May help a game's audio or Zink. All games started with mako-launch, from their next start.
